plantedBugs.description: No authorization check — any authenticated user can query any candidate by ID. Missing org_id ownership verification.
assessments resolver is N+1 — GraphQL will call this once per candidate in a list query. For 100 candidates this is 100 DB round-trips. Should use DataLoader.
SELECT * returns all columns including PII (email, phone). Should explicitly select only fields defined in the GraphQL schema.
scores resolver uses IN subquery — functional but could be a single JOIN with GROUP BY for better performance.
